planItem: 77.44.7.A — Inspector edit, Canvas, Save, and published renderer lifecycle
finding: The broad authored-content browser lifecycle used a 6-second action timeout and only a 12-second live-page navigation timeout despite mounting every content type and exercising Inspector, Canvas, Save, reload, and Publish. Repeated runs timed out at different steps without a stable failed assertion.

testHarnessChange.rationale: Align the resource-heavy full lifecycle fixture with the 15-second action and 30-second navigation budgets used by the related Inspector lifecycle suite.

tests.previousObservedFailures: Three serial runs timed out at varying points: Canvas locator, initial navigation, and a keyboard press. The assertions were unchanged.

cases.editorInspectorLifecycle: PASS 1/1; 250.4 seconds; selection, Inspector edits, undo, Save/reload, separate Publish, Canvas/public renderer parity
cases.editorMediaSourceSwitch: PASS 3/3; 390px and 1366px source switching and failed-commit recovery
cases.editorLegacyMediaParity: PASS 1/1; legacy image/video/audio Inspector, Canvas, and Save/Publish

editorContentSystem.coverage: Authored-content Inspector field routes, Canvas changes, accessible validation, Save, reload, and separate Publish

release.requiredAction: Push the test and documentation update as a normal fast-forward; no Worker deployment is needed.
release.health: Runtime release health and asset hashes were verified in inspector-persisted-media-kind-2026-10-30.json. This test-only update does not alter those assets.

acceptanceBoundary: This stabilizes the automated full authored-content lifecycle test. It does not certify all of 77.44.7.A or the complete Visual Editor; consolidated manual and physical-device acceptance remains deferred until the complete Editor is implemented.
